benchmarkDenominator.warning: This is a cloned static inventory, not upstream runner parity. The full runner was not executed because upstream test-pandoc and test-pandoc-lua-engine must be built as Haskell Tasty executables from a full checkout; the current cache is blob-filtered/no-checkout with mass working-tree deletions, and running Cabal would require hydrating the broad checkout plus downloading/building Pandoc's dependency graph. ghc 9.10.3 and cabal 3.12.1.0 are on PATH, but stack is not. Native PHP progress maps 197 focused Markdown/HTML/WordPress writer checks, including the prior Markdown, table, DocBook, row-span, image, link, footnote, inline, smart punctuation, and LaTeX slices plus both the two-level nested table and the full HTML document third-level nested-table warning/degradation case from test/command/nested-table-to-asciidoc-6942.md, the test/tables/nordics.html5 structured HTML table caption/thead/tfoot/colgroup shape, and bounded test/html-reader.html/native cases for hard paragraph line breaks, inline q/cite quote spans, small-caps/underline/strikeout inline marks, the two standalone pre/code CodeBlock nodes from the HTML reader Code Blocks section, the eight BlockQuote nodes from the HTML reader Block Quotes section, the top-level Lists section tight and loose bullet/ordered lists, multiple-paragraph ordered items, and six ordered-list style metadata cases, omitted section tags, inferred table heads, RowHeadColumns 1 row headers, colspan/rowspan cells, attribute-carrying table nodes, two native multiple-TableBody tables including the second case's paragraph-bearing cell, four native TableBody head-row cases, the four plain Tables without Headers body-only/body-omitted/empty-head/body-plus-foot shapes, and the two empty-table inputs omitted from Pandoc's native output. The WordPress writer policy for the nested-table case is intentionally target-specific: preserve the third-level nested table HTML for import review instead of applying Pandoc's AsciiDoc-only two-level downgrade.
